narrative.rotation_signal: Clear rotation INTO financials (WFC, JPM, MA, AXP), energy (XOM, CVX), and mega-cap tech/AI (NVDA, META, AAPL, MSFT, AMD, INTC, IBM), and OUT OF defensives (WMT, PM, ABBV, MRK), semi-equipment/memory (LRCX, MU, AVGO), and industrials (GE, RTX, HD). Note the semi split: design/logic names bullish while equipment and memory bearish — institutions are selective, not blanket-long tech.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: AVGO bearish here despite broadly bullish semi complex (NVDA/AMD/INTC all bullish) — watch for semi-industry read to lag this divergence. HD bearish with dark pool 10.0/blocks 9.85 is unusually heavy size for a consumer-discretionary bellwether and may front-run a retail-sector downgrade. LLY bullish while MRK/ABBV bearish flags intra-pharma dispersion the industry layer may mask.
